children.content:
# 🛠️ Complete Jenkins CI/CD & Pipeline Automation Track

Welcome to your full Jenkins learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-jenkins-architecture` | **Architecture & Server** | Controller (Master) & Agent nodes, JNLP connection, Docker setup |
| `01-declarative-pipeline-syntax` | **Declarative Pipelines** | `pipeline`, `agent`, `stages`, `steps`, `options`, `parameters`, `triggers` |
| `02-scripted-pipeline-and-groovy` | **Scripted Pipelines** | `node {}`, Groovy scripts, `script {}` blocks, closures, loops |
| `03-environment-variables-and-parameters` | **Environment & Params** | `environment {}`, String/Choice parameters, `currentBuild` metadata |
| `04-credentials-and-secret-management` | **Secret Management** | `withCredentials()`, Username/Password, Secret Text, SSH keys |
| `05-docker-pipeline-integration` | **Docker in Pipelines** | `agent { docker { image '...' } }`, `docker.build()`, container isolation |
| `06-multibranch-pipelines-and-git` | **Multibranch & Git** | Multibranch pipelines, PR verification, Webhooks, `checkout scm` |
| `07-parallel-execution-and-matrix` | **Parallel & Matrix** | `parallel {}` execution, build matrices, optimizing CI pipeline time |
| `08-when-conditions-and-filters` | **Conditional Execution** | `when { branch 'main' }`, `when { tag 'v*' }`, `when { changeRequest() }` |
| `09-post-actions-and-notifications` | **Post Actions & Alerts** | `always`, `success`, `failure`, Slack/Email notifications, JUnit reports |
| `10-shared-libraries-groovy` | **Shared Libraries** | `@Library('...') _`, custom reusable steps in `vars/`, OOP helper classes in `src/` |
| `11-artifact-archiving-and-stash` | **Artifacts & Stash** | `archiveArtifacts`, `stash` & `unstash` between distributed agents |
| `12-input-approvals-and-gates` | **Manual Approvals** | `input message: '...'`, production deployment approval gates, timeouts |
| `13-kubernetes-dynamic-agents` | **K8s Dynamic Agents** | Kubernetes Pod agents, ephemeral executor pods, auto-scaling agents |
| `14-security-rbac-and-audit` | **Security & RBAC** | Role-Based Authorization Strategy, Project matrix security, audit logs |
| `15-jenkins-casc-jcasc` | **Configuration as Code** | JCasC (`jenkins.yaml`), declarative server configuration & provisioning |
| `16-blue-ocean-and-monitoring` | **Blue Ocean & Metrics** | Blue Ocean visualizer, Prometheus plugin, build performance dashboards |
| `17-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield Jenkins CI/CD interview questions & debugging scenarios |

---

## 🛠️ Quick Start

Run local Jenkins server using Docker Compose:
```bash
docker compose up -d
```
Access UI at: `http://localhost:8080`

### Shared Library Structure:
```
(root)
+- src/                     # Java-style Groovy source files (OOP)
|   +- com/company/Util.groovy
+- vars/                    # Global variables and custom steps (callable in Jenkinsfiles)
|   +- standardBuild.groovy
+- resources/               # Static non-Groovy data files
```

# 17 - High-Yield Jenkins CI/CD Interview Questions 🎯

### Top 5 Interview Questions:
1. **Declarative vs Scripted**: Declarative provides structured, syntax-checked DSL; Scripted offers full Groovy programming flexibility.
2. **withCredentials vs ENV**: `withCredentials` prevents secret leakage by automatically masking tokens in console output.
3. **Multibranch Pipelines**: Automatically detects branches containing `Jenkinsfile` and triggers builds on PR creation.
4. **Shared Libraries**: Centralizes reusable CI/CD logic across multiple repository pipelines.
5. **Dynamic Kubernetes Agents**: Scales executor pods on demand and terminates them post-build to save cloud infrastructure costs.

🚀 You have completed the complete Jenkins CI/CD Automation track!
